title: Stasis Aurora
description: A young boy with messy brown hair and large steampunk goggles resting on his forehead stares directly at the viewer with a somber expression. He wears a brown leather jacket adorned with metal gears and buckles, set against a dramatic arctic mountain landscape under a vibrant green and purple aurora borealis.
prompt: A somber young boy with tousled brown hair and large ornate steampunk goggles on his forehead, wearing a brown leather jacket with visible gears and straps, stands centered in the foreground looking straight at the viewer. Behind him is a dramatic rocky mountain range under a swirling, luminous green and purple aurora borealis in a starry night sky. Floating in the upper right is a complex steampunk flying machine made of gears and metal. Text reading STASIS in the top left and AURORA in the bottom right.
